title: How IPL Teams Actually Make Money

segments.text: Every IPL season, teams spend crores on players, and still make a profit.
How does that even work? Let's break it down.
The biggest chunk comes from broadcast and streaming deals, shared among all ten teams.
That central pool alone covers most of a team's player salaries.
Then come jersey sponsors, helmet logos and stadium boards.
Each logo slot on a jersey is sold separately, for crores.
Home matches bring ticket money, food stalls, and merchandise.
Smaller than media rights, but it's pure local profit.
